name: 25-convert-claude-messages-tools-kept
description: convertClaudeMessages with `useSysPrompt` false and `useTools` true: the `tool_use` / `tool_result` content parts are kept as tools. An assistant turn's `tool_calls` array becomes `tool_use` parts with its function `arguments` parsed by `parse` (:233 as `JSON.parse` on a string, anything else passed straight through), and a `tool` turn becomes a one-part `tool_result` user turn carrying its `tool_call_id` (:244-251). Those two user turns then merge (:348-349), and the trailing assistant turn closes the exchange. The `name` on the plain user turn is folded into the text and then deleted (:273-275, :310), and the tool turn's `tool_calls` / `tool_call_id` keys are removed (:311-312).
